integrity: The proof independently expands the exact published phase vector field at the saddle, solves the local unstable-manifold invariance equation to quadratic order, converts the phase expansion to geometric slope and radial-ratio variables, and derives the power law from a first-order asymptotic differential equation. The bundled checker verifies the critical symbolic identities.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns only the nontrivial profile branch whose phase trajectory tends to p4=(pi/2,pi/4). The leading coefficient is dilation-dependent; only its positivity and the exponent are universal. The publisher PDF was not openly accessible during verification, so bibliographic noncoverage is based on the relevant publisher-indexed phase-system and classification passages plus targeted searches.
title: Sharp contact order at the diagonal end of Kim's Minkowski profiles
